chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan and others from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Supplicate with this supplication after the two rak'ahs of the obligatory Tawaf, saying after the Tashahhud: 'O Allah, have mercy on me through my obedience to You and my obedience to Your Messenger (peace be upon him and his family). O Allah, keep me from transgressing Your limits and make me among those who love You, and love Your Messenger, and Your angels, and Your righteous servants.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite after the two rak'ahs of Tawaf?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes a concise du'a to be recited after the two rak'ahs of Tawaf, emphasizing the spiritual fruits of obedience (tawaa') and love (hubb). It highlights the Shia emphasis on the interconnectedness of divine love, angelic witness, and righteous servitude as criteria for mercy and protection from transgression.
